ai_index_ids.description: The AI indices that dreaming promotes the memory into. Each must exist in this space, and the caller requires the Elasticsearch `write` privilege on its backing index.

attributes.description: String hints about the memory for dreaming. Accepts up to 50 entries, with non-blank keys of 1 to 256 characters.

content.description: The memory text. Elasticsearch indexes this field for semantic search.

id.description: The id of an existing memory to revise. The revision replaces the memory in full, and the route does not check whether the id exists. Omit this field to generate a new id.

session_id.description: The session the memory comes from.

user_id.description: The Kibana user profile UID that the memory belongs to. Omit this field to use the caller's user profile. Naming another user requires `contextEngine:manage_memory`.
